doc: Seeded, PLATFORM-OWNED render-time helpers. DO NOT EDIT.

params.name: name
params.doc: DNS-label step name: the step's folder under steps/ and part of its image name.

params.name: kind
params.doc: Required. What the step does; the platform labels the step's pod and HPC job with it. ingest, publish and control steps never run on an HPC class.

params.name: reads
params.doc: Config sections (top-level keys of the config/ tree) the step reads; checked at render. They are the step's params: it gets these sections and no other.

params.name: inputs
params.doc: Names of the top-level config values that hold a dataset reference. Each is pinned to one commit when the run starts; step code names the input, never a version.

params.name: needs
params.doc: Steps this one runs after; each one's result reaches this step (kaos_lib.step.upstream).

params.name: produces
params.doc: What the step writes: model('name'), artifact('name') or dataset('name').

params.name: when
params.doc: A condition in plain words: a run-form field or a value of a needed step compared with a text: 'mode != off', 'evaluate.passed == true', joined with and / or; the step is skipped when it is false.

params.name: walltime
params.doc: The default time limit of the step, wherever it runs: '90m', '12h' or '720' (minutes). The person who starts the run sets the limit on the run form (<step>-walltime); 4h when not given.

params.name: resumable
params.doc: True or a lead time ('20m', '1h'): how long before its time limit the step is told to save its checkpoint; False opts out.

params.name: checkpoint_every
params.doc: The default for how often the platform copies the step's checkpoint folder: minutes ('20m', '1h', 20); False = no copies; unset = the platform default (a resumable step has the field too). The person who starts the run can change it on the run form (<step>-checkpoint-every).

params.name: idle_timeout
params.doc: How long a step may show no GPU use and no new log line before it is ended as Idle: minutes ('40m', '1h', 40); 0 or False = never; unset = the platform rule.

params.name: matrix
params.doc: Values to try: {'lr': [0.01, 0.001], 'batch': [16, 32]}. The step runs once for each combination (at most 32); read a value as step.params['lr']. The run form can change the combinations and how many run at once. The step may not produce a dataset.

params.name: matrix_allow_failed
params.doc: With matrix=: True lets the step after it run when some runs failed (it then sees which); by default one failed run fails the step and the whole run.

removed.outputs: outputs= is gone. Declare what the step writes with produces=[...] and hand it on with step.result().
removed.hpc_time_limit: hpc_time_limit= is gone. Use walltime=, for example walltime="12h".
removed.disk: disk= is gone. The step gets the disk of the machine class it runs on.

produced.model: a trained model, stored with the run
produced.artifact: any other files of the run
produced.dataset: a new version of a dataset this step alone writes

old_app_marker: Create it again from the template.
